source_note: 绘图主体由清单设想的高石券整体调整为实照可辨的阁体正面、下层前廊和即时台地。采用H2v5o68z两张2025-05-03 CC0实拍；不采用模糊抠图Wahuang Palace 2.png。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes.  Subject: Wahuang Pavilion 娲皇阁 at Wahuang Palace, She County, Hebei, as shown in these 2025 actual photos. Draw the cliff-attached main pavilion, not the detached side gate or another temple. The main facade has THREE upper wooden levels identified in the photo by the three stacked plaques, and a LOWER stone/cave porch level, making FOUR visible horizontal eave lines. Upper roofs stack above one another with gently raised corners; the lowest wide porch roof is broad and shallow. Preserve the front columns, open cave-hall entrances, narrow stone terrace and low railing visible at foot, with just a few sparse cliff outlines directly behind to establish it hugs rock. No invented huge stone arcade or freestanding tower, no invented rear elevation. This illustration selects the complete pavilion facade from roof to immediate terrace; omit the neighboring stair pavilion blocking its foreground. Transform steep photographed perspective to a near-frontal view while retaining the actual four roof lines and realistic compact proportions. Keep apex, both roof corners and immediate base entirely within broad white margins. Remove visitors, lanterns, notices and ALL Chinese characters. Use very sparse contour marks in cliff and no rock shading. Landscape plate with generous white breathing room.

historical_sources.title: 历史年代与现存主体依据
邯郸文旅／北京文旅宣传中心：娲皇阁四层与石券上三层木阁

site_recommendation.name: 娲皇宫及石刻
site_recommendation.yearNote: 河北省文物局将山上娲皇阁等列明清遗物；邯郸文旅记明代于石券上增建三层木阁。1600仅作明清阁体的约值排序，未据北齐刻经年为阁体断代。
site_recommendation.coordinate_source: Commons Category:Nüwa Imperial Palace 公布36°38′36″N,113°37′02″E，山上主体附近定位：https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Nüwa_Imperial_Palace 。
site_recommendation.lede: 娲皇阁依着涉县凤凰山崖壁而立。石窟与石券上叠起三层木阁，层层檐线紧贴山势，北齐刻经与明清建筑在此相邻。

facts.label: 现存年代
facts.text: 图中阁体按明清遗构收录；周边北齐摩崖刻经年代更早，二者不混作同一营建年。

facts.label: 四层关系
facts.text: 底层天然石窟外作石券，上置三层木阁，组成四层主体；图版呈现可见阁面和下层前廊。

facts.label: 构图
facts.text: 依2025年实拍绘贴崖正面与近前台地，略去遮挡的邻近亭阁，不重建未见的后部与高台剖面。

coordinates.source: Commons Category:Nüwa Imperial Palace 公布36°38′36″N,113°37′02″E，山上主体附近定位：https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Nüwa_Imperial_Palace 。

quality_check.notes: 四道实际檐线及阁前栏台已核实；岩壁仅少量轮廓，未增加无照片依据的高大石券立面。
